phases.title: Version 2.0 - Core Scraping API
phases.description: Establish a robust, configuration-driven system for data collection.

tasks.title: Implement Flexible Scraping Engine
tasks.description: Create the core `crawlConcertVenue` service using Firecrawl, supporting multiple extraction modes.

tasks.title: Build Unified API Endpoint
tasks.description: Develop the `POST /api/scrape` route to handle all scraping requests.

tasks.title: Set Up Data Persistence
tasks.description: Ensure scraped data saves correctly to JSON files and optionally to a Supabase `events` table.

tasks.title: Define Configuration Types
tasks.description: Create TypeScript types for `CrawlConfig` and `StorageOptions` in `types/scraping.d.ts`.

phases.title: Version 2.5 - User Accounts & Personalization
phases.description: Build the foundational layer for user-specific data and interactions.

tasks.title: Set Up Supabase Authentication
tasks.description: Implement user login, logout, and profile management using Supabase Auth.

tasks.title: Create User Profiles Table
tasks.description: Design and create the `profiles` table with a foreign key to `auth.users`.

tasks.title: Implement Hometown Feature
tasks.description: Allow users to set and update their hometown in their profile.

tasks.title: Create Core Data Tables
tasks.description: Design and implement the `venues` and `artists` tables in Supabase.

phases.title: Version 3.0 - Venue & Artist Following
phases.description: Connect users to the data that matters most to them.

tasks.title: Implement Venue Following Logic
tasks.description: Create the `followed_venues` table and the backend logic to follow/unfollow venues.

tasks.title: Implement Artist Following Logic
tasks.description: Create the `followed_artists` table and the backend logic to follow/unfollow artists.

tasks.title: Build 'My Profile' Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a UI where users can view and manage their followed artists and venues.

phases.title: Version 3.5 - The Personalized Feed
phases.description: Deliver the core value proposition of the app: a personalized concert feed.

tasks.title: Develop Personalized Feed Logic
tasks.description: Write the Supabase query to fetch events based on a user's followed artists and venues.

tasks.title: Build the Feed UI
tasks.description: Create the React components to display the upcoming shows in a clean, chronological list.

tasks.title: Implement Empty State UI
tasks.description: Design a component that guides new users to follow artists/venues if their feed is empty.

phases.title: Version 4.0 - Notifications & Discovery
phases.description: Enhance user engagement with notifications and music discovery features.

tasks.title: Set Up Email Notifications
tasks.description: Implement a service (e.g., Supabase Edge Functions with Resend) to email users about new shows.

tasks.title: Develop Artist Discovery Algorithm
tasks.description: Create a simple recommendation engine to suggest new artists to users.
